results: Broad ceiling: target-stream unigram floor 26.82%, any-k oracle 27.51%, teacher argmax agreement 6.4% on wiki vs 70.2% home; oracle 52.7% vs measured 36.5% home (#437).
Two-sided keying 31.0% / 6.94 bits vs Rule 1+2 26.4% / 8.27 (non-causal); causal marginal 25.91% top-1 negative but bits better by 0.897 (#447, #454).
Capacity-scaled cover: regions 48 to 110, region-path top-1 +5.0pp, serving impact capped near 0.15pp by exact-context dominance (#460).
Codebook fit only +0.44pp (2.1 SE), below the +1.0pp exit rule (#460).
Bott-Fock ceiling: lossless upper bound +0.16pp as shipped, 'mechanism sound, constant wrong' (#424, #475).
Content-vector query +0.1363 MRR; lexical weight W=0 gave +0.022 MRR (#490, #494, #502, #504).
IPF consistency operator reaches only the unigram floor; overlapping blocks do disagree (#499, #505).
eras.why_it_ended: Teacher breadth identified as binding constraint (#437), directing work to the SmolLM2-360M broad-corpus program (#509, #320); latent right-class family closed dead for top-1 (#455).
knowledge_to_keep: On broad text the ceiling was the teacher signal, not representation; a better teacher beat every clever store trick (#437, #509).
Latent right-class marginalisation is dead for top-1 but its calibration gain (bits 15.48 vs 22.21 at 2.11M) survived (#446).
Fixed-threshold cover splits do not scale with corpus size; capacity must scale with N (#460).
Bott-Fock context fold should be retuned (decay >>2 to >>7) before any revival (#424).
